name: canny
label: Canny
description: Product feedback management platform. Collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests from your users.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Canny secret API key. Find it at Settings → API in your Canny admin dashboard.

create_post.label: Create Post
create_post.description: Creates a new post on a Canny board.

authorID.label: Author ID
authorID.description: The unique identifier of the post author (Canny user ID).

title.label: Title
title.description: A brief title describing the post.

details.label: Details
details.description: The longer description of the post.

byID.label: By ID
byID.description: The unique identifier of the admin creating the post on behalf of the author.

categoryID.label: Category ID
categoryID.description: The unique identifier of the category to assign.

ownerID.label: Owner ID
ownerID.description: The unique identifier of the user responsible for completing the work.

eta.label: ETA
eta.description: The estimated delivery date in MM/YYYY format (e.g. "06/2026").

etaPublic.label: ETA Public
etaPublic.description: Whether the ETA should be visible to all users.

customFields.label: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Custom fields as key-value pairs (keys max 30 chars, values max 200 chars).

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: Original creation date in ISO 8601 format, for migrating posts from another source.

retrieve_post.label: Retrieve Post
retrieve_post.description: Retrieves the details of an existing post by its ID.

id.label: Post ID
id.description: The unique identifier of the post.

list_posts.label: List Posts
list_posts.description: Returns a list of posts for a board, with optional filtering and sorting.

boardID.label: Board
boardID.description: The board to list posts for (optional — omit to list across all boards).

search.label: Search
search.description: A search query to filter posts.

status.label: Status
status.description: Comma-separated list of statuses to filter by (e.g. "open,planned").

skip.label: Skip
skip.description: Number of posts to skip (for pagination).

create_vote.label: Create Vote
create_vote.description: Casts a vote on a post on behalf of a user.

postID.label: Post ID
postID.description: The unique identifier of the post to vote on.

voterID.label: Voter ID
voterID.description: The unique identifier of the voter (Canny user ID).

delete_vote.label: Delete Vote
delete_vote.description: Removes a vote from a post for a given user.

postID.label: Post ID
postID.description: The unique identifier of the post to remove the vote from.

voterID.label: Voter ID
voterID.description: The unique identifier of the voter (Canny user ID).
